rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday word for a restaurant.

example.english: We're going to that restaurant for dinner tonight.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚去嗰間餐廳食飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 heoi3 go2 gaan1 caan1 teng1 sik6 faan6

rows.note: Use this for a Hong Kong-style casual café serving drinks and inexpensive meals.

example.english: The milk tea at this restaurant is really famous.
example.traditional: 呢間茶餐廳嘅奶茶好出名。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 caa4 caan1 teng1 ge3 naai5 caa4 hou2 ceot1 meng2

rows.note: Use this broader, more formal term especially in writing or when referring to eateries collectively.

example.english: The district has many restaurant choices.
example.traditional: 區內食肆林立，選擇非常多。
example.jyutping: keoi1 noi6 sik6 si3 lam4 lap6 syun2 zaak6 fei1 soeng4 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically for a fast-food restaurant or quick-service food shop.

example.english: I'm rushing back to work, so I'll grab a sandwich at a fast-food restaurant.
example.traditional: 我趕住返工，去快餐店買個包算喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gon2 zyu6 faan1 gung1 heoi3 faai3 caan1 dim3 maai5 go3 baau1 syun3 laa3
